findings.title: Donor guard requires unsupported Level method and unsupported exact-wire type
findings.trigger: Any opted-in registration operation with an installed real CinderLevel donor, including the new ordinary-lunge host, B02 support host, pause/checkpoint/Retry/Leave.
findings.evidence: Line973 unconditionally calls active_level.authority_state(). Neither frozen current Level nor the observed Level candidate declares it; B02 and new native-lunge hosts also omit it. Existing tests/fixtures/restore_candidate_level alone declares a TEST-specific authority_state returning body_transform: Transform3D (frozen262). ExactJSON._encode supports only nil/bool/String/int/float/Array/Dictionary (frozen46–92), so even that helper dictionary cannot be inserted into Exact.stringify(rows) at976. Empty donor guard is refused at1113 before readiness.
findings.implication: First Begin/Title with no donor can avoid this branch, but later actual donor operations cannot satisfy the shared guard. Parser/runtime failure type has not been observed; this is a source-only unsupported contract call and transport mismatch.
findings.bounded_repair_direction: Use declared Player/Level/Shell closed snapshot interfaces and encode necessary native donor observations separately using an existing native-byte representation; do not add a new authority_state requirement to every level. Preserve genuine donor identities/state without relaxing readiness checks.

findings.title: Startup cancellation flag leaks into the next operation failure
findings.trigger: A public request_retry/leave_side/quit queued while initial saved-game registration wait is pending; queued Retry is the concrete traced case.
findings.evidence: _cancel_registration_preparation raises epoch and leaves _registration_cancelled=true. On prepared=false, _finish_startup_load skips attempts.load_saved but never clears the cancellation flag before scheduling queued _drain. Attempts remains empty; queued Retry returns false at319–320 before calling any _prepare_registration that would reset the flag. _commit_drain then takes218–220 and treats that new genuine failure as cancellation of the previous startup, silently dropping it instead of retained/displayed failed-operation handling.
findings.implication: Pending startup cancellation and subsequent operation failure are different epochs/owners. The old boolean can suppress the new operation result. This is a deterministic source trace; actual GUI availability during initial Title load and native output remain untested.
findings.bounded_repair_direction: Clear/consume startup cancellation ownership before releasing startup latch, or attribute canceled return to its own operation epoch. Preserve queue and unchanged Attempt/disk authority; no universal one-frame assumption or synchronous validator conversion.
